Liquid Glass algorithm attribution

Source: QWEA0/Liquid-Glass-Android
https://github.com/QWEA0/Liquid-Glass-Android
Commit: 16afe4d8b5d08a370d3f8c50b08d7f5c6eb5da4d

GlassSurface.kt adapts rounded distance fields, numerical normals, inward
inverse-power refraction, dispersion and directional reflection from
liquidglass/src/main/java/com/example/liquidglass/GlassLensRenderer.kt.
GlassPairLensShader.kt and LiquidGlassButtonPair.kt additionally adapt its
two-shape polynomial smooth-min. Compose capture and integration, transformed
ellipse correction, opacity, bounded touch and shadow handling are local changes.
GlassButtonDeformation.kt adapts directional press/stretch behavior from
LiquidGlassView.kt, with local Compose gesture arbitration and animation.
ScrollingGlassHeader.kt adapts scroll-edge masking from ScrollEdgeBlurView.kt.

The upstream library and native modules are not included as dependencies.

LiquidGlassFusionSurface.kt reuses the same fixed smooth-min lens for measured
rounded rectangles. Separation-based connection, per-shape tint and Compose
fallback ownership are local adaptations; coloured-medium absorption/scattering
is adapted from the same fixed GlassLensRenderer.kt source.

The 0.1.23 repair gates the toolbar neck by measured transform changes and a
bounded fade after motion stops. Cached contour shadows and the shared SDF
shadow use locally normalized user reference parameters. Dark coloured-medium
scattering is increased without replacing page transmission with an opaque
white fill. These motion, shadow and tuning changes are local adaptations.
